key.name: show-percentage
key.description: Display the active provider usage percentage next to the icon.

key.name: enable-cursor
key.description: Fetch and show Cursor plan usage.

key.name: enable-codex
key.description: Fetch and show Codex plan usage.

key.name: enable-claude
key.description: Fetch and show Claude Code plan usage.

key.name: active-provider
key.description: Provider shown in the panel and selected in the popup. One of "cursor", "claude", or "codex".

key.name: cursor-state-db
key.description: Optional path to Cursor state.vscdb. Empty uses the default location.

key.name: cursor-auth-json
key.description: Optional path to cursor-agent auth.json. Empty uses the default location.

key.name: codex-auth-json
key.description: Optional path to Codex auth.json. Empty searches the default locations.

key.name: claude-auth-json
key.description: Optional path to Claude Code .credentials.json. Empty searches the default locations.
